title: Google sign-in is the standard: default on, stable Cognito domain from site.json
description: Ryan's firm requirement: CMS sign-in is Google, always. The new Pilobol.us CMS (app dv0pdx67fk80m) fails LOGIN with 'oauth param not configured' because its pool has no hosted-UI domain and no Google provider. Fix the template so a site created from it gets Google by default with a stable Cognito domain (cms.cognitoDomainPrefix in infra/site.json), update synth tests and docs. No AWS changes.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Root cause: (1) Pilobol.us infra/site.json (main) sets `PAPYRUS_DISABLE_GOOGLE_OAUTH=1` and the template copies cms.environment to the branches; `defineSiteAuth` creates the Cognito domain only inside the Google block, so no domain and no provider. (2) Live: the console GitHub connect at 13:09-13:10 EDT deleted the stack-made `main` and `staging` branches and recreated only `main` with NO env vars (CloudTrail), so the 17:10Z build created UserPool + client, no UserPoolDomain, no IdP. Fix in PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/134 (branch feature/PPY-cee38d-google-sign-in): required `cms.cognitoDomainPrefix`, template sets PAPYRUS_COGNITO_DOMAIN_PREFIX, rejects the disable flag, synth tests, docs. CI python+ts pass. Not merged.

right_now_summary: PR #134 adds default Google sign-in and a stable Cognito domain; CI passes, but it is not merged.
